verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an agent payments and identity platform, for example auto top-ups or actions fired on charge or settlement events. The evidence pack documents no user-definable rules, triggers or event-driven actions. Seller identity requirements, API-key scoping and automatic buyer-agent creation at signup are fixed platform behaviors or adjacent controls, not user-defined rules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
